title: helianthemum variabile var. plantagineum
intro: Helianthemum variabile var. plantagineum, commonly known as the rockrose or wild rosemary, is a perennial plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Helianthemum variabile var. plantagineum include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, pain relief, and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
